title: EpiFlow: Bridging Safety and Performance in Offline Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Guided Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2602.08054v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising framework for deploying autonomous systems in safety-critical settings without the risks of online exploration. However, learning policies that simultaneously achieve high performance and strong safety guarantees from fixed datasets remains a fundamental challenge. Many existing safe offline RL approaches typically rely on soft constraint formulations, which may permit safety violations and are sensitive to distributional shift. In contrast, formal methods such as Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability and Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide rigorous safety guarantees, but often yield overly conservative solutions, often neglecting performance. In this work, we bridge this gap by formulating safe offline RL as a state-constrained optimal control problem, where safety is enforced through hard state constraints and performance is captured via a reward function. translated_abstract: 离线强化学习（RL）为在安全关键环境中部署自主系统提供了一个有前景的框架，而无需承担在线探索的风险。然而，如何从固定数据集中学习同时实现高性能和强安全保证的策略，仍然是一个根本性的挑战。许多现有的安全离线RL方法通常依赖于软约束的表述形式，这可能允许安全违规的发生，并且对分布偏移较为敏感。相比之下，Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析和控制屏障函数（CBFs）等形式化方法能够提供严格的安全保证，但往往产生过于保守的解决方案，常常忽视性能。在这项工作中，我们通过将安全离线RL表述为一个状态约束最优控制问题来弥合这一差距，其中安全性通过硬状态约束来强制执行，而性能则通过奖励函数来刻画。由此产生的
tldr: 该论文提出EpiFlow方法，将安全离线强化学习建模为状态约束最优控制问题，利用上镜图引导的流匹配同时实现基于硬状态约束的严格安全保证与高性能策略学习。
en_tdlr: EpiFlow formulates safe offline RL as a state-constrained optimal control problem and leverages epigraph-guided flow matching to achieve both rigorous safety guarantees through hard state constraints and high policy performance.
